name: std-bench-development-profiles
purpose: Bounded real std_bench E2E presets for edit-test loops; never paper timing evidence.

quick-e2e.purpose: Default short real E2E check across three distinct allocator-facing collection paths.
quick-e2e.stop_policy: Each leaf has a 12-second cap. Stop on the first failure or timeout and fix that case before broadening.

family-smoke.purpose: Non-claim regression coverage across every top-level std_bench family.
family-smoke.stop_policy: Each leaf has a 20-second cap. Stop on the first failure or timeout; do not broaden to the full surface until the focused failure is fixed.

pathology.purpose: Isolate known high-cost cases one at a time; a reproduced timeout or pathological slowdown is sufficient diagnostic evidence.
pathology.stop_policy: Run exactly one singleton with a five-second observation budget. On timeout or obvious pathological degradation, keep the bounded evidence and stop.

recommended_shards.reason: Key materialization and sort cost sentinel.
Million-entry iteration and memory pressure sentinel.
Huge rotation and memory bandwidth sentinel.
